title: Air Ship
body:
The Air Ship is a vehicle that not a lot of people know how to use. Its controlled with WASD and LSHIFT/LCONTROL, LSHIFT and LCONTROL are for going up and down, W/S are forward and backward, A/D is steering, the airship has tank steer meaning it will always have the same rotational control no matter which direction you are moving, and can turn at any time.

Trivia

Airship can’t be used to transport cargo.

It is only available on testing servers.

It’s maximum speed is 35 studs per second.

It is SLOW. Oakmobile or Optimus Vehicle are better for general purposes.

It can be found at the oak depot behind the register
